function globMatch(pattern, text) {
  const tokens = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
    const c = pattern[i];
    if (c === '\\') {
      if (i + 1 < pattern.length) {
        tokens.push({ type: 'lit', char: pattern[i + 1] });
        i++;
      } else {
        tokens.push({ type: 'lit', char: '\\' });
      }
    } else if (c === '*') {
      tokens.push({ type: 'star' });
    } else if (c === '?') {
      tokens.push({ type: 'any' });
    } else {
      tokens.push({ type: 'lit', char: c });
    }
  }

  const tokenCount = tokens.length;
  const textLength = text.length;
  const dp = Array.from({ length: tokenCount + 1 }, () => new Array(textLength + 1).fill(false));
  dp[0][0] = true;

  for (let i = 1; i <= tokenCount; i++) {
    const token = tokens[i - 1];
    for (let j = 0; j <= textLength; j++) {
      if (token.type === 'star') {
        dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] || (j > 0 && dp[i][j - 1]);
      } else if (token.type === 'any') {
        dp[i][j] = j > 0 && dp[i - 1][j - 1];

        dp[i][j] = j > 0 && token.char !== undefined && text.charCodeAt(j - 1) === charCode && dp[i - 1][j - 1];
      }
    }
  }

  return dp[tokenCount][textLength];
}

module.exports = globMatch;
